meta.suite_set_rule: the registered modelless-eligible dataset suites with n >= 100 at run time (the Bench-092 gate-6 rule); every exclusion named; --suites overrides (disclosed)
meta.seat_rule: the strict-majority core over the K-primary prefix (first-appearance tie order); empty core = the seat abstains; unanimous disclosed beside; the K sweep (2/8) is a PREFIX of one 8-transform decision set — zero extra decides
meta.fused_rule: the fused gate IS the identity transform's decide (the production input): answered+pick or abstained, read from the engine slot verdicts
meta.verdict_rule: G2a passes iff BOTH pooled paired LB95s > 0 (semantic-placebo on the both-answer pairing; semantic-fused at matched coverage); G2b the same on its pair, scored on the fused-answered set with the extra abstention scoring 0; LB95 = mean - 1.6449·SE, pooled with suite fixed effects; G3 (the null path) fires when G2a fails BOTH bounds — the negative is scoped to this run table, THIS engine (bag-of-hashed-words additive features), the tested families

pooled.g2a: NEGATIVE (G3) — both pooled bounds <= 0: the additive-transform class is bounded on this engine, this run table, these families
pooled.g2b: NEGATIVE — the empty-core channel shows no placebo-separated lift
